look_here_first: Inspect flowers SIDE-ON and measure the narrow corolla tube: 6–9(–10) mm. A. longiflora is (20–)28–41(–45) mm. Check sepals (0.8–1.8(–2) mm), leaves and eventual follicles. Do not assign var. texana from species-only records.

morphology_keys.habit: Upright perennial herb with leafy stems.
morphology_keys.leaves: Simple narrow leaves; inspect nodes and leaf margins for hairs.
morphology_keys.flowers: Five-lobed salverform flowers; tube 6–9(–10) mm; sepals 0.8–1.8(–2) mm.
morphology_keys.fruit: Paired narrow follicles; confirm from mature specimens.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Use measured corolla tube length rather than blue flower color. Var. texana is not automatically identified from a parent-species observation.
